desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed Escape Brainrot! Run, train, morph, and escape through chaotic new worlds while becoming faster every second.

⚡ Every step gives EXP
🏃 Run, jump, and race through wild obstacle stages
🧠 Morph into powerful Brainrots for insane speed boosts
💸 Collect Cash and upgrade your progression
✨ Unlock Auras, Trails, and multipliers to go even faster
🎁 Open Lucky Blocks for rewards
🌊 Dodge crushers, lava, tsunamis, and deadly hazards
🌍 Reach new areas and become faster than everyone else
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and become the fastest runner on the server

🎧 Smooth movement, satisfying speed effects, crazy morphs, and nonstop brainrot chaos included.

💎 Features:
Brainrot morphs with hyperspeed boosts
Every step makes you faster
Cash upgrades and progression
Powerful auras and trails
Lucky Blocks with rewards
AFK treadmills and training
Dangerous crushers, lava, tsunami, and hazards
Fast-paced speed simulator gameplay
New stages, new areas, and harder escapes
Leade
